localChanges: When you watch a game with no human player, the bar along the top of the map now offers the whole map, with every square and every city and unit on it, or the game as any set of its civilisations see it together: tick the ones you want and the map shows everything any of them knows, with the first one's details in the panel (#613).

Watching a game, what the civilisations you watch are told of now comes as notices beside the actions, to read or ignore, rather than windows to close one by one while the game plays on. A turn's notices stay until the turn after it has come, so paused between turns you can read the last turn's (#613).

Watching a game, you can click any city of a civilisation you watch, or any city at all on the whole map, to see its screen as a Diplomat's investigation shows it: everything in it, nothing you can change (#613).
